item.title: [New] Intune at Ignite: software compliance policy marks devices running unsanctioned AI agents noncompliant for Conditional Access (preview); container policies for agents; vulnerability remediation agent (limited preview)
item.description:
Unapproved AI agents on endpoints become something compliance can block, and the remediation agent can patch devices automatically, so change records and alert baselines must expect agent-initiated patching.

Intune · Inventory AI agents on Windows endpoints with Defender, decide which MSI product codes to mark noncompliant, and pilot the software compliance policy in report-only Conditional Access first.

item.description:
A new DLP enforcement point on network traffic produces new DLP alerts and Activity explorer events from Azure Firewall.

Purview · Identify which firewalls would be in scope and who owns tuning before enabling the preview policy location.

item.title: [New] Purview DLP will cover local AI agent prompts, responses and tool calls (preview late January 2027, GA late April 2027)
item.description:
Local coding and desktop agents are an unmonitored exfiltration path today; this is the first Purview control on them.

Purview · Inventory local agents in use (Defender local agent discovery) so the preview policies can be scoped when they arrive.

item.title: [Message Center] MC1558038 Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: Network data security integration with Azure Firewall
item.description:
Microsoft Purview integrates Data Loss Prevention with Azure Firewall to protect sensitive network traffic, including text, files, and AI interactions. Rolling out from mid-November 2026 (preview) to late April 2027 (general availability), it enables automatic tenant activation, policy configuration, and enhanced risk management without disrupting existing policies.

Microsoft Purview · stayInformed

item.title: [Message Center] MC1558037 Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: Protection for local AI agent interactions
item.description:
Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention is expanding to protect sensitive data in supported local AI agent interactions, allowing administrators to apply DLP policies to agent prompts, responses, and tool interactions. Public preview starts late January 2027, with general availability by late April 2027. No action is required to enable this feature.

item.description:
A retention or DLP policy targeted with a new adaptive scope will silently stop covering inactive mailboxes and soft-deleted owners once the default lands, which matters for legal hold and leaver retention.

Purview · Note the new dates; before April 2027 decide whether retention scopes must include inactive and soft-deleted recipients and document it in the scope-creation runbook.
